metadata.title: Coach Ahmed Samra | Professional Tennis Coaching & Academy
metadata.description: Top-tier tennis coaching & private lessons in Egypt with Coach Ahmed Samra. Technique correction, tactical plans, tournament preparation, and ranking improvement.

hero.heading: Professional tennis coaching.
hero.description: Comprehensive technical and physical development with expert coaching.

about.heading: About Ahmed Samra
story: Ahmed Samra is a tennis player and coach focused on clear player development.

roles.title: Tennis Player

achievements.heading: Training built on detail.
achievements.introduction: The focus is clear progress on court.

services.heading: Your plan to compete and develop.
services.introduction: Cleaner technique, sharper tactics, a higher ranking, and a clear path to clubs and national teams.

cards.title: Winning tactics
cards.description: Tactical guidance and plans for better match decisions.

cards.title: Improve your ranking
cards.description: A training and competition plan to improve your ranking.

cards.title: Clubs and national teams
cards.description: Clear development for stronger opportunities with clubs and national teams.

pricing.heading: Invest in Your Tennis Game.
pricing.introduction: Flexible coaching programs tailored for all age groups and skill levels.

items.name: Assessment Session
items.description: On-court skill analysis to pinpoint exact technical strengths and development areas.
features: Complete on-court stroke and movement testing
Analysis of tactical and technical strengths
Clear recommendations for your optimal training path

items.name: Private Coaching (1-on-1)
items.description: Intensive 1-on-1 on-court coaching with Coach Ahmed Samra for rapid, tangible results.
features: Stroke mechanics and precise footwork correction
Tactical simulation of actual match scenarios
Immediate on-court guidance and live feedback

items.name: Academy Membership
items.description: Structured group training program over 12 intensive sessions with matched-level players.
features: Weekly match play and competitive rallies

items.name: Rally & Match Simulation
items.description: High-tempo rally and practice match to test composure under real point pressure.
features: Simulation of official match conditions and pressure
High-tempo rallies for shot depth and consistency
Fast tactical feedback to improve point decisions

items.name: Custom Technical Reports
items.description: Detailed written assessment, tournament preparation, or match tactical analysis.
features: In-depth written analysis of stroke mechanics
Permanently stored in your private player portal

testimonials.heading: Trust built through the quality of training, not words alone.
testimonials.introduction: Professional placeholder feedback shaped around what players and parents value most: structured coaching, growing confidence, clear technical improvement, and discipline that supports long-term development.

cards.author: Parent
cards.quote: The strongest part of the experience is the clarity of the plan. The player understands what to train, why it matters, and how each step builds confidence and discipline.

cards.author: Junior Player
cards.quote: Training helped me understand my mistakes in a simple way. I feel more confident with my shots and more focused during practice and matches.

cards.author: Competitive Player
cards.quote: The attention to technical and tactical details made a real difference. Every session has a clear goal, and every review helps me make better decisions on court.

cards.author: Parent
cards.quote: Progress shows not only in technique, but also in discipline, confidence, and the way the player approaches training and competition.
